answer: Every submission must name 2 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The grove graph is validated at intake and the onyx frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and fable anchors the chain at a checkpoint. The arithmetic runs against the attacker: 243 aliases cost 316 times the entry price, and a 28 day hold keeps that capital locked for the whole attempt. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
